name: 雾蓝绵密泡沫温和洁面乳款
description: 软管洁面乳绵密泡沫、温和清洁、洗后舒适不紧绷

styleLock.backgroundSystem: clean pure white #FFFFFF for packshots and trust, foam-mist white #F3F7FA for info and scene, cool grey marble #ECEDEE and #EAECEE stone for lifestyle, deep steel teal #3F6E99 only for the closing shot
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft cool studio lighting, front-left key with gentle bounce fill, soft contact shadows, one skimming side light reserved for macro texture, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: cool grey marble #ECEDEE and pale stone vanity #EAECEE tabletops with airy foam textures
styleLock.iconSystem: minimal thin-line icons in one accent color only
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and scale for the tube across the set; foam always rendered as dense fine bubbles
noDrift: no invented certifications or efficacy numbers
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh foaming cleanser visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of foam-mist white #F3F7FA, tube mist blue #A8C8E0, steel teal accent #3F6E99 and ink teal text #2F3E4D; bright soft cool studio lighting with a front-left key, gentle bounce fill and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif; minimal thin-line icon style; clean high-key skincare photography over airy foam textures and cool marble surfaces; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 逐屏事实：P1 浅蓝软管躺于泡沫水面并配鲜叶；P2 浅蓝圆角卡六宫格线性图标（六格文字为模板占位词，与洁面产品无关）；P3-P4 大理石底拍立得空白卡与『231,987次赞』式社证模板版式；P5 掌心托泡沫特写；P6-P7 芦荟与玻璃器皿图、洋甘菊/燕麦条图及皮肤分层插画（活力控油/改善毛孔等属功效断言）；P9 pH试纸图与『温和清洁不紧绷』深蓝卡；P10 深蓝卖点卡与会员二维码角标。品类判定：图内英文 Foaming Cleanser、软管形态、掌心泡沫特写、pH 试纸与洁面话术构成硬证据，判为护肤个护/面部护理（leaf 洁面乳），源夹名『美妆』按图改判，未落入美妆彩妆（无着色彩妆证据）。已剥离：品牌字标与水字、会员徽标与二维码、点赞数等社证数值、全部功效断言（控油、改善毛孔、舒缓肌肤压力、改善肤质、保湿补水等不作事实写入）、pH 数值（不作弱碱性宣称）、模板无关文案（一机多能等家电话术）；所有数值一律换成 {callout_n}/{selling_point_n} 或空白 proof 占位（空印章框、空背书卡）。与近似件差异逐条：① 色板 #F3F7FA/#A8C8E0/#3F6E99/#2F3E4D 经查重均未在面部护理段出现，深钢青 #3F6E99 作收口底在同类洁面件中未见；② vs suite-hufugehu-anyisuan-anyabeng-paomo-jiemian（cool 冰蓝云朵体系）：本套弃用云朵泡沫台与冰蓝拱门，改用大理石灰 #ECEDEE/#EAECEE 石质台面体系（源自源图 marble 版式）；③ vs suite-hufugehu-zifapao-jiemianru（亦有绿色嫩枝道具）：本套弃用植物枝条，改用拍立得式空白卡位与空白背书印章位为签名道具；④ 机位体系：高 45° 俯视双栏同构对比 + 低角度仰拍收口 + 90° 顶拍平铺的组合在该 L1 段洁面件中无重复；⑤ 角色序列：PAIN_POINT 前置第 3 镜、COMPARISON 用泡沫质感而非皮肤前后对比、TRUST 用空白背书位而非任何证书检测图形。
